تجتنبون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَنِبُونَ (tajtanibūna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ni.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# تُجْتَنَبُونَ (tujtanabūna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.na.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
